text:
sam: Quick sync 1: we need a clear contract for config dry-runs vs applies. Support keeps hitting us for traceability.

marta: Console currently shows diff+simulation but no stable id. We should return a preview_id.

dyson: Agreed. Preview must be read-only and never emit production SLO metrics. It should write an audit event and light telemetry only.

laura: API suggestion: POST /v1/configs/preview -> { preview_id, diff, simulation, warnings }. preview_id should be usable to fetch audit entries.

ankur: Telemetry sampling: default 1% for previews. Add a schema flag for sensitive keys (auth/quotas/kms) that forces 100% logging when present. Tag events with preview_id and sensitive=true.

ryan: Console UX: show a prominent "PREVIEW (not applied)" badge with preview_id and an action "Promote to canary" that preserves the exact delta and cohort. Also surface estimated cost/QPS delta.

sam: For apply semantics: add X-Config-Mode header: preview|preflight|apply. Preflight runs the simulator synchronously with a 5s timeout and fails fast with 409 + details if constraints/capacity checks break.

dyson: Implement capacity guard in preflight: compare expected QPS to pool capacity*headroom. If failing, return remediation steps (increase pool, enable fallback routing). No side-effects on routing metrics.

marta: Dashboard/History: include a "Pending changes" lane showing preview_id, preflight_id, apply attempts. Telemetry keys: config.preview.request, config.preview.sampled, config.preflight.result, config.apply.attempt. All carry the correlating ids.

laura: I'll draft the API wire and example curl with preview_id. dyson/ankur will add audit + sampling + sensitive escalation + capacity guard. ryan/marta will mock console flows.

sam: Cool. Tagging @dyson @laura @ankur @ryan. ops-bot: reminder about deploy window.

ops-bot: Reminder: next config deploy window Tue 02:00 UTC. Preflights must finish before window to be included.
